title: Invoice Maker – JetRise Pro

title: SnapPDF – PDF Scanner
description: Scan documents and receipts, create PDFs, merge and split files, use OCR and share documents. Free download with optional Pro features; in-app purchase prices are shown by the relevant store. Available for iPhone, iPad and Android.

title: RentWise: Landlord Rent App
description: Track rent payments, tenants, leases, property expenses, maintenance and cash flow. Free starting tier with optional Pro upgrade; store pricing varies. Available for iPhone, iPad and Android.

title: Trading Journal
description: Log trades and track net profit and loss after charges, ROI, win rate, drawdown and performance analytics. Free download with optional Pro analytics and reports. Available for iPhone, iPad and Android.

title: Jetrise Hydrate
description: Track daily water intake with hydration reminders, goals, streaks and progress tracking. Free download with optional Pro upgrade. Available for iPhone and iPad.

title: Habit Tracker
description: Build routines with habit streaks, reminders, badges and progress insights. Free download with optional Pro upgrade. Available for iPhone and iPad.

title: QR Studio: QR Maker & Scanner
description: Create QR codes for websites, Wi-Fi, contacts and business use, and scan QR codes. Free tools with platform-specific pricing or upgrades shown in the relevant store. Available for iPhone, iPad and Android.

title: StatementSnap
description: Convert bank statement PDFs or CSV files into reviewed transactions and an Excel spreadsheet. First import and export are free; optional Pro unlocks more use. Available for iPhone and iPad.

title: Fairloom
description: Split rent fairly between roommates using room size and property features. Free download with optional Pro upgrade. Available for iPhone and iPad.

title: RentScope
description: Analyze rental income, expenses, cash flow and investment returns for rental properties. Free download with optional Pro upgrade. Available for iPhone and iPad.

title: RentMate – Rent Manager
description: Record rent payments, tenants and property expenses in a simple rent management app. Free download with optional Pro upgrade. Available for iPhone and iPad.

title: Math Buddy
description: Practice math with short lessons, activities and skill-building exercises. Free download with optional Pro upgrade. Available for iPhone and iPad.

title: Vedic Maths Tricks
description: Learn mental-math shortcuts through step-by-step lessons and practice. Android download is free with optional Pro; iOS store pricing may differ. Available for Android and iPhone/iPad.

title: Story Spark
description: Explore child-friendly writing prompts with ideas, tips, read-aloud and sample answers. Free download. Available for iPhone and iPad.

title: GridFlow
description: Play a daily number-path logic puzzle designed to exercise problem-solving skills. Free download with optional Pro upgrade. Available for iPhone and iPad.

title: TipMate – Smart Tip Calculator
description: Calculate restaurant tips and split bills with friends. Paid iOS app; listed price is USD 2.99 on the JetRise app catalog.

title: Daily Inspire Quotes
description: Read, save and share uplifting daily quotes. Free download. Available for iPhone and iPad.

title: Project Planner: Task Tracker
description: Plan projects with scope, timelines, estimates, progress tracking and task checklists. Free download. Available for iPhone and iPad.

title: Naam Jap Counter: Japa Mala
description: Count mantra repetitions with a 108-bead counter, streaks and a home-screen widget. Free Android app with no ads.

title: JobReady: Punch List & Photos
description: Create job checklists with photos and notes for contractors and export PDF handover reports. Free Android download.

title: WriteOff: Receipts & Mileage
description: Scan receipts and record business mileage, organize expenses and review tax-time deduction summaries. Free Android download with optional Pro.

title: FieldPulse: Farm & Tractor
description: A farm app for families and home growers to track fields, tasks, harvests, animals and money, with crop learning and a 3D tractor activity. Free Android download.
